title: Cleaning Business Spreadsheet Template | Google Sheets Client Tracker, Invoice and Payment Log, Expenses, Monthly P&L
description:
Run your cleaning business from one Google Sheet instead of a stack of sticky notes and half-finished invoices. Built for cleaning and maid service owners who want to see who they cleaned for, what they billed, what's been paid and what they actually made this month.

Enter a client's details once and they flow through to every tab. No typing the same information over and over.

WHAT'S INSIDE (7 tabs)
- Start Here: step-by-step guide to getting started
- Settings: set your services and rates
- Clients: enter each client once
- Jobs: log every job with dropdowns for client, service and status (Scheduled / Completed / Cancelled)
- Invoices: filled in automatically, with Payments Log columns to record what's paid and see what's overdue
- Expenses: log costs with category and payment method dropdowns
- Monthly P&L: calculated automatically

BUILT TO STAY WORKING
- Dropdowns keep entries consistent
- Date columns check for valid dates
- Formula columns warn you before you type over them
- Sample data included so you can see how it works before adding your own
- Every formula is recalculated and checked before release. The sample file checks out with zero formula errors.

HOW YOU GET IT
This is an instant digital download. You'll receive a PDF with a 'Make a copy' link that creates your own editable Google Sheet. You need a free Google account. It runs in Google Sheets in your web browser; no software to install.

FAQ
Can I change the services and rates? Yes, on the Settings tab.
Do I have to re-enter client info on every tab? No. Enter a client once and it flows to Jobs and Invoices.
What if a formula doesn't work? Message us and we'll fix it.
Is anything physical shipped? No. This is a digital file only.

Designed by Template Studio with the help of AI tools; every formula is checked by us before release.
